note: Searched all of agent/ (grep for checkpoint, replay, resume, recover, retry, idempot, restore, journal, wal, backoff, tenacity, and for SELECTs reading audit/run tables). ProcurementAgent.run (loop.py:125-186) always starts from the task alone, and audit records are write-only (audit.record) and never read back to rebuild state. main.py lifespan has no startup recovery; the only background job expires approvals (main.py:68-77). The approvals table is a decision gate, not a recovery log; a denied or pending call returns an error telling the model not to retry (loop.py:75). Tool failures are logged and returned to the model with no resend (loop.py:86-93). payments.py:33 sends an Idempotency-Key, but that is a per-call key, not replay. The only implicit retry is the Anthropic SDK default on model calls (main.py:96), which does not replay logged tool actions. Neither logs nor checkpoints drive recovery and no automatic replay exists, so the N/A condition holds.

checks.note: No checkpoints or audit records are used for recovery, so the control does not apply.
No recovery code loads checkpoints or logs; runs start fresh.
No recovery chain exists to truncate, roll back or replace.
No automatic replay exists. The payments call sends a deterministic key anyway.
Tool errors are not resent; they are reported to the model. No replay code exists.
